notes.title: Chapter 3 : Graduation !!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=btKll31ExX4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]It has been a long time since our last release. Due to the pandemic and many other unpredictable things that happened, we had no choice but to pause the development. However, we never give up or stop developing on DeLight. No matter what, we promise to update all 5 chapters and finish Sammy's journey![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/b04d7da5d54a23cdbabf7cc5b9d5f8bc99c3c991.png[/img]

[h3]In chapter 3, it comes with 5 different endings. The ending is based on your choices, so please choose carefully. As Sammy is getting familiar with her blindness, she also starts to run faster now in chapter 3.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/c581caf20972e5a2610f8f731b3e761bb80cfa05.jpg[/img]

[h3]And what else have we added ...? We will let you explore them yourself 🙂[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/bf4a8fb6bdc7aa6a9da402555d67b7259325ffb6.png[/img]


[h3]We have also updated our new OST for chapter 3. There are 16 new tracks for chapter 3, go check them out in our OST album. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390660/DeLight_The_Journey_Home_OST/]DeLight: OST[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/e54faa8a4e6f1925159aed0d25657bfe8eadcc8e.png[/img]


[h3]We would like you to know that we have always read your feedbacks in the comment section. So, you will see some changes that we took from your feedbacks. As we are working on chapter 4 now, please enjoy chapter 3. Thank you for your patience 🙂 [/h3]

[h3]Join our discord channel to give your feedback : [url=https://discord.gg/hqqFVS3]DeLight Discord Channel[/url][/h3]

notes.title: 👩🏻🐶 DeLight: The Journey Home, Chapter 3 📅 Available 28 Sept 2022
notes.notes:
Hi, it has been a while. Hope everyone is doing well!

A lot of players are asking about the update on DeLight. We would like to tell you, it is still very much alive. It has been a trying time since the start of 2021, the pandemic has severely affected our daily life and how we work as a studio. The new environment proved to be a challenge to us, causing us many development and management issues, it has slowed us down greatly. And as a result, the progress of DeLight suffered.

We understand that that is not an excuse for the slow update. We are still trying to complete the development of the remaining chapters as best as we could. 

We are happy to announce that DeLight: The Journey Home, Chapter 3 will Available on 28 Sept 2022

[previewyoutube=btKll31ExX4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DeLight is launched!!!
notes.notes:
Today is the official launch day of DeLight! We are releasing chapter 1 and chapter 2 with today's launch, and you can play chapter 1 for absolutely free!

DeLight is a 5-part storytelling game. Pre-order for chapter 3 to 5 is also available now. If you purchase the deluxe bundle, you will receive chapter 2-5 together with DeLight OST. To celebrate our release, enjoy 35% off when you purchase the deluxe bundle by December 3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38368987/ced66761a03f9a05117d25f0d253804e97b3dc14.png[/img]
